lines.en: : It is possible these strange feelings inside of me are the result of what humans call “puberty” as well.
lines.zh: : 我体内这些奇怪的感觉，说不定也是人类所说的「青春期」造成的。

lines.en: : That seemed to be the popular result when I researched the way I was feeling on SpiderwebMD.
lines.zh: : 我在 SpiderwebMD 上查自己的症状时，最热门的结果似乎就是这个。

lines.en: : That’s not a thing.
lines.zh: : 没这个网站。

lines.en: : Yes it is.
lines.zh: : 有的。

lines.en: : Also, you’re too old for puberty. You’re what, 22?
lines.zh: : 还有，你早就过了青春期了。你多大来着，22？

lines.en: : In human years, yes. But 154 in dog years.
lines.zh: : 按人类年龄算，是的。但按狗的年龄算是 154 岁。

lines.en: : Probably 155 now.
lines.zh: : 现在大概 155 了。

lines.en: : Why is it that dogs move through space and time quicker than humans do, Friend?
lines.zh: : 为什么狗在空间和时间里穿行得比人类快呢，朋友？

lines.en: : Do you think they could bestow their knowledge unto us?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它们会把知识传授给我们吗？

lines.en: : You seem to have the ability to speak with John, so perhaps you could speak to a dog as well?
lines.zh: : 你看起来能和 John 说话，那说不定也能和狗说话？

lines.en: : If you speak to a dog, could you also inform him that I love him?
lines.zh: : 如果你和狗说上话了，能不能也转告它，我爱它？

lines.en: : You haven’t even seen this fictional future-dog yet.
lines.zh: : 你连这只虚构的未来之狗都还没见过呢。

lines.en: : I have not. But I love all dogs so I am sure I will love whichever one reveals the secrets of the universe to you.
lines.zh: : 是没见过。但我爱所有的狗，所以无论哪一只向你揭示宇宙的奥秘，我肯定都会爱它。

lines.en: : Sounds good, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错，Kaori。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to include that in the conversation I will definitely have with a dog in the near future.
lines.zh: : 在不久的将来，我一定会和一只狗说上话的，我保证到时候把这句话也带上。

lines.en: scene kaorishugecock19
: One more entry for the friendship journal!
lines.zh: : 友谊日记又多了一条！

lines.en: : Thank you very much!
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你！

lines.en: scene black
Kaori and I (And I guess John) continue to chat for a while longer and eventually buy another pizza from that shop we’ve been to before.
lines.zh: Kaori 和我（大概还有 John）又聊了一会儿，最后从我们以前去过的那家店又买了一个披萨。

lines.en: Kaori only eats one slice and then feeds the rest to the chicken- something I would not advise actual chicken-owners to do.
lines.zh: Kaori 只吃了一片，剩下的全喂给了那只鸡——这事儿我可不建议真正养鸡的人学。

lines.en: Eventually, it comes time for me to leave and the two (Or three) of us part ways and head back to our respective homes.
lines.zh: 终于到了该走的时候，我们两个（或者三个）分道扬镳，各自回家。

lines.en: I take a quick shower to get any residual farm-animal stench off of me before I put some fresh clothes on and head out the door...
lines.zh: 我快速冲了个澡，洗掉身上残留的农场动物臭味，然后换上干净衣服出门……

lines.en: $ kaoridate5 = True
$ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
